GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2015-07-27T06:41:32Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Service call from JS no longer works with default Type parameter
Description: I got a Service wich used single default Type parameters like this

``` csharp
interface IMyAppService
{
       GetEntity(long id);
}
```

In previous version i could call this method from javascript. But since i updated to the current version the call no longer works. I had to change to:

``` csharp
interface IMyAppService
{
       GetEntity(GetEntityInput input);
}
class GetEntityInput
{
        public Id {get; set;}
}
```

to make it work again. 

Was this change intended cause you are againts using default types in service parameters like you described in your articles or is this some unintended change?
